title: Repair accepted DATA PING producer and handoff lineage gap
objective: Diagnose why current handoff reports latest_accepted_data_ping as unavailable while the accepted DATA PING bridge implementation remains on current main and its expected accepted-root is absent. Implement the smallest code-only repair that restores truthful producer, activation and lineage semantics without fabricating historical accepted packets.
allowed_change_scope: tests directly related to accepted DATA PING bridge and latest handoff behavior
the exact existing accepted-DATA-PING producer or activation workflow only if fresh-state repository discovery proves it is the current owner

evidence.summary: Current handoff exposes latest_accepted_data_ping as unavailable.
The root consumed by the handoff builder is absent on current main.
Current main retains the implementation intended to hash, deduplicate and persist immutable accepted DATA PING packets and receipts.
The current handoff builder still scans research/data_ping_bridge/accepted, so this lineage remains an active routing surface.

reproduction: On fresh main, read LATEST_HANDOFF.json and confirm latest_accepted_data_ping is unavailable; inspect build_latest_handoff.py and confirm it scans research/data_ping_bridge/accepted; confirm that root is absent; inspect accepted_data_ping_bridge.py and determine whether the bounded defect is missing producer/activation wiring, stale routing after intentional retirement, or another implementation-lineage mismatch before changing code.

positive: When an immutable accepted packet exists, latest handoff resolves to that exact packet path and content hash; when none exists, the handoff remains truthfully unavailable.
Replaying the same snapshot does not create a second accepted packet.
Tests cover missing-root, present-root and duplicate-snapshot behavior.
If producer wiring is repaired, a production-shaped run proves writer and handoff consumer agree on path and contract.
negative: No historical accepted DATA PING packet may be fabricated, reconstructed or backfilled.
Action Compass receipts must not be silently reclassified as accepted DATA PING packets.
No parallel accepted-ping engine or pointer may be created when the existing owner can be repaired.
No market or portfolio behavior may change.

post_fix_gate: CI plus main readback and one production-shaped lineage observation with no duplicate or fabricated accepted packet.
